metadata.purpose: Deprecated nested-property projection implemented as a map; preserves value order and timing.

cardinality.signature: pluck(path) : T* -> U* (one output next per source next)
conditions: Every source next yields exactly one projected value, even if the property is missing.
The source error/completion and the downstream cancellation control termination; there is no inner Observable.
Projection does not share, resubscribe or schedule the input.

scope.parameters: One to three non-empty own/plain-data string property keys; no empty paths.
scope.callbacks: No user callback; read nested plain data directly as in the pinned map-based implementation.
scope.time: No clock or scheduler is introduced; every projected output occurs in its source notification step.
scope.reentrancy: Atomic non-reentrant source notifications and primitive/plain-object property access.
exclusions: Getters and proxies with side effects or throws, symbol keys, dynamically mutated paths.
Constructor-time error for zero path elements is represented by factory rejection, not a stream notification.

initialization.sourceSubscription: Exactly one source subscription per result execution.

ownership.sharing: None; each subscription independently projects one source.
ownership.reset: New downstream subscription resets count; no caches or shared Subjects.

dispatch.actionSemantics: Synchronous notification forwarding, no invented timers.
cancellationCheckpoints: Between source notifications; a cancelled result cannot receive more values.

rules.explanation: One independent cold execution begins for each downstream subscription.

rules.guard: plain-data property path can be read
actions: emit one nested property value, including undefined
rules.explanation: Walk the configured keys in order. A null or undefined intermediate stops the walk and produces undefined.
rules.nextState: Active with source value count increased by one.

rules.explanation: The operator adds no values on completion.

actions: forward exact error and release source
rules.explanation: Source failure is not converted into a property value.
